summary: fractal-web sidebar folders follow the owner's native arrangements: the live arrangement named exactly "Sidebar" with the lowest UUIDv7 wins, and every owner-wide arrangements frame re-reads the complete list

replay.detail: Read-only client projection; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: Uses the existing arrangements list route and owner-wide arrangements subscription. Daemons without owner inventory invalidation still serve the sidebar, but cannot announce changes outside the subscription window.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; the app is not deployed by this change.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
